name: FillWise
summary: A Chrome extension that fills web forms and PDFs from pasted text, a photo, a scan or a file, with a free starting allowance.
description: FillWise is an AI form filler for web forms and PDFs (fillable and flat). You paste text or drop a passport photo, scan or PDF as the source data. Official pricing: every paid plan has the same features and differs by volume. Free includes 5 fills a week and 20 fills to start, no card. A fill is one web form, or a PDF of up to 5 pages with fields (longer PDFs cost one fill per started 5 pages). An attached photo or PDF used as data is included up to 10 pages, then adds one fill per started 10 pages.

pricing.details: Free: 20 fills to start, then 5/week, no card. Individual 17 €/month (100 fills); Professional 67 €/month (500 fills); Agency 312 €/month (3,000 fills, priority support). A fill is one web form, or a PDF of up to 5 pages (then one fill per started 5 pages).
pricing.label: Freemium

features: Chrome extension that fills web forms and PDFs
Source data from pasted text, a photo, a scan or a file
Works on fillable and flat PDFs
